newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher on technical buying.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Wednesday on technical buying by local investors, traders said.
Prices were 80 to 180 yen higher at the close, with the benchmark May 1998 contract up 110 yen at 13,590 yen per tonne. The day's estimated trade volume was 78,307 lots.

On Tueday, All months of Tokyo corn futures plunged by the daily 500 yen limit on the yen's steep gains against the dollar. Local investors regarded the price losses on Tuesday were excessive, traders said.
At 0830 GMT, the spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was $2.77 per bushel, up from the $2.76-1/4 Tuesday close.
The spot July soybean contract on the CBOT overnight trading system stood at $8.45-1/4 per bushel, against $8.45 at Tuesday's close.
